title: Setup prompt wording is pinned by ordered substring assertions in the test
answers: how to change the mlflow agent setup prompt text
why does test_setup_sh_unit fail after rewording a checklist step
which test checks the agent tracing instructions
body:
The agent prompt is plain text emitted by printf in build_agent_prompt in mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh. Each output line is one quoted argument, and "" marks blank separator lines.
tests/agent/test_setup_sh_unit.py:test_build_agent_prompt_requires_repo_summary_and_realistic_trace_input asserts that the "## N." headers appear in ascending index order and that specific phrases are present, such as "mlflow.note.content", "Prefer MLflow autologging", and "mlflow.update_current_trace(session_id=...)".
It also asserts that retired phrases are absent ("Trace URL opens", "exercise one traced operation"), so reintroducing old lines fails the test.
When you reword a step, update the matching assertion in the same change and keep the asserted casing and punctuation. The test runs the backend=remote branch only, so the databricks branch of build_agent_prompt is not covered by it.
applies: Changes to prompt text in build_agent_prompt; not for other setup.sh functions.
says: Update the setup prompt instructions to tell the coding agent to prefer automatic logging.
Reword the setup assistant guidance for attaching session identifiers to active traces.
Remove retired instructions about opening the trace web link from agent setup prompts.
The onboarding agent prompt still mentions exercising one traced operation during setup.
Modify the setup instructions explaining how to add documentation notes to an experiment.
search: Prompt text in mlflow/agent/setup/setup.sh:build_agent_prompt is emitted via printf and verified by substring assertions in tests/agent/test_setup_sh_unit.py:test_build_agent_prompt_requires_repo_summary_and_realistic_trace_input. The test asserts ascending header order, verifies required phrases like 'mlflow.note.content', 'Prefer MLflow autologging', and 'mlflow.update_current_trace(session_id=...)', and rejects retired phrases such as 'Trace URL opens' and 'exercise one traced operation'. Rewording a step requires updating the test's exact casing and punctuation assertions in the same change. The test exercises only the backend=remote branch, leaving the databricks branch of build_agent_prompt uncovered.
